knock.name: Mallet click
knock.description: The mallet's contact on the wood at each strike (its own for each mallet), against the recording. The left end is off.

sympathetic.name: Gourd buzz
sympathetic.description: How strongly the gourds' membranes buzz with each bar (their noise and the fundamental's harmonics): 100 % as recorded, 0 off, more exaggerates it.
